changed title from **Add support for {-three -}attributes defined in {-NAN -}Spec R4 (DCEA, NIRA, and NPBA)** to **{+WiFi(Nan): +}Add support for attributes defined in Spec R4 (DCEA, NIRA, and NPBA)**
why create a local __offset ?

Hi Alexis,

I found it would be easier to use a local \__offset to access the content in the NIRA.

The way WFA organise NIRA is kind of counter intuitive. Some fields may or may not present based on the type and status. It would be less trouble for me to read from the attributes using \__offset and updated every time I parse something, so that next time I can just using \__offset. 

If you would prefer not to use this, just letme know. I can change this as well.

Thanks,

Jie
